$note: The declarative set of SHIPPED artifacts the signed build manifest covers (W4-3 #443). Each entry is hashed against the tree root by tools/build_manifest.py at release time; the four artifact KINDS the plan names — Python, Rust, the browser bundle, the gateway image — are all present here, so none ships without an identity. A 'file'/'tree' path is content-addressed from disk; an 'image' digest is injected at generate time via --image NAME=sha256:<hex> (from `docker inspect --format '{{index .RepoDigests 0}}'`) because a container image is not on the filesystem. Paths are relative to the tree root passed to `generate`.

artifacts.name: python-core
artifacts.why: the shared integrity substrate (the registry-shippable wheel) — Python

artifacts.name: warden-kernel
artifacts.why: the compiled Rust WARDEN kernel binary — Rust (present only after `cargo build --release`)

artifacts.name: browser-bundle
artifacts.why: the command-console browser bundle — the artifact the old build id covered ALONE

artifacts.name: gateway-image
artifacts.why: the sandbox gateway container image — identified by its content digest (injected at generate time)
